simple.meaning: מִשְׁמֶרֶת (mishmereth) is a Hebrew action word meaning “watch , i.e. the act ( custody ), or (concretely) the sentry , the post ; objectively preservation , or (concretely) safe ; figuratively observance , i.e. (abstractly) duty or (objectively) a usage or party.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 78 times in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 13 more, beginning at Genesis 26:5. The surrounding contexts include commandment, Torah, land, wilderness, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁמֶרֶת (H4931) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מִשְׁמֶרֶת (mishmereth) / H4931 is traced through Genesis 26:5, Exodus 12:6, Exodus 16:23, Exodus 16:32 with source-language evidence and verse context.
